Massage Services in Bellevue, WA

Every session is tailored to your comfort, goals and preferred pressure. Browse our massage services, then choose your time.

01

Swedish Massage

A gentle, relaxing full-body massage that improves circulation, eases tension, promotes overall well-being and calms the nervous system.

02

Sport Massage

Focused work for injury prevention, muscle recovery, improved performance, flexibility and post-workout tension relief.

03

Foot Reflexology

Pressure applied to specific points on the feet to promote relaxation, ease fatigue, improve energy flow and support full-body balance.

04

Deep Tissue Massage

Targeted work for deeper layers of muscle and connective tissue to relieve chronic pain, stiffness and tension while improving mobility.

05

Ashiatsu Massage

A barefoot massage technique using deep, broad pressure to release tight muscles, reduce stress and improve flexibility and posture.

06

Four Hands Massage

Two therapists work in sync to create an immersive, luxurious experience that enhances relaxation and sensory harmony.

07

Couples Massage

Share a calming massage experience side by side with a partner, ideal for special occasions, reconnection and shared wellness time.

08

Prenatal Massage

Comfort-conscious massage adapted for pregnancy, with positioning and pressure tailored to each guest.

09

Insurance Massage

Learn how to verify eligible massage therapy benefits before scheduling your Bellevue appointment.

Choosing the right massage

For broad relaxation and everyday tension, start with Swedish massage. If you prefer slower, targeted work, explore deep tissue massage. Active guests may consider sports massage. Your therapist can adjust pressure and focus based on your comfort and goals.
